subject: general
question: Which organisation successfully developed an indigenous nanoporous multilayered polymeric membrane for high pressure seawater desalination in May 2025?

options.text: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Defence Research & Development Organisation (DRDO)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Defence Research & Development Organisation (DRDO)** successfully developed an indigenous nanoporous multilayered polymeric membrane for high-pressure seawater desalination in May 2025.
 
• This innovative membrane technology is crucial for addressing **water scarcity** through efficient seawater desalination.
 
• The membrane technology is designed to handle **high-pressure environments**, making it suitable for industrial and defense applications.
 
• The initiative underscores DRDO's commitment to fostering **self-reliance** in critical technologies and supporting India’s **Make in India** mission.
 
• DRDO’s achievement represents a significant step forward in the development of **advanced materials** for strategic and civilian purposes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Defence Research & Development Organisation (DRDO):**

 
 
• The DRDO is India’s premier agency for research and development in defense and strategic technologies.
 
• Established in **1958**, its headquarters are located in **New Delhi**.
 
• DRDO is known for developing cutting-edge technologies such as missile systems, radar systems, and advanced materials for various applications.
 
 
 
• **Nanoporous Multilayered Polymeric Membrane:**
 
 
• These membranes are engineered with **nanoporous structures** that enable the separation of salt and impurities from seawater.
 
• The multilayer design enhances durability and efficiency, allowing it to function under **high-pressure conditions**.
 
• Such membranes are essential for **reverse osmosis processes** in desalination plants.
 
 
 
• **Applications of Membrane Technology:**
 
 
• The technology is used in the production of **safe drinking water** from seawater, addressing global water scarcity issues.
 
• It is applicable in **defense operations** where access to clean water in remote locations is crucial.
 
• Industries such as pharmaceuticals and food processing also utilize membrane technology for purification processes.
 
 
 
• **Make in India Initiative:**
 
 
• The development of indigenous technologies aligns with India’s **Make in India** campaign, which aims to boost local manufacturing and reduce dependency on imports.
 
• DRDO’s focus on developing such technologies contributes to strengthening India’s strategic autonomy.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Reverse Osmosis (RO) Technology:**

 
 
• RO technology is widely used for water purification by removing contaminants and salts from seawater or brackish water.
 
• It utilizes **membranes** that allow water molecules to pass through while blocking larger particles and impurities.
 
 
 
• **Water Scarcity in India:**
 
 
• India faces significant challenges in ensuring access to clean water, especially in coastal areas where seawater desalination could be a viable solution.
 
• Innovative technologies like nanoporous membranes play a crucial role in mitigating these challenges and ensuring water security.
